propwash.race.config.score_areas.tooltip: Shows the fly-through area of the next gate and the scoring areas of flags, slalom poles and gate poles – subtle, clearer while building. Off while spectating and with F1.
propwash.race.edit.open_edges.tooltip: Report gaps: open spots in the edge glow red. Ignore gaps: the gate counts with an incomplete edge, and “Rescan” fills the rectangle spanned by the blocks that are there.
propwash.race.edit.score.role.tooltip: None: just an obstacle and marker. Pass: counts like a slalom pole. Turn: counts like a turn flag. In a course, “None” only works after “Remove from course”.
propwash.race.edit.score.side.tooltip: Which side the drone has to pass on, or which way it has to turn around the pole, seen in the direction of flight.
propwash.race.edit.score.reach.tooltip: How far from the pole passing or turning still counts, in blocks.
propwash.race.edit.score.below.tooltip: Scoring still counts this many blocks below the foot, 0 to 32 in half steps. A tall flag on a pillar or on a gate then counts all the way down to the ground.
propwash.race.edit.score.above.tooltip: Scoring still counts this many blocks above the top, 0 to 32 in half steps. 0: flying over the top doesn't count.
propwash.race.edit.nudge.step.tooltip: Step size for moving with the mouse wheel, −/+ and the arrow keys. Ctrl always moves by 1/16 block (one pixel), Ctrl+Shift by 1/32 block.
propwash.race.edit.nudge.x.tooltip: Moves it east (+) or west (−) from where it stands in the world, up to 8 blocks.
propwash.race.edit.nudge.y.tooltip: Moves it up (+) or down (−), up to 8 blocks. Without the free mouse: Page Up and Page Down.
propwash.race.edit.nudge.z.tooltip: Moves it south (+) or north (−), up to 8 blocks. Without the free mouse, the arrow keys move it relative to where you look.
propwash.race.score.reset.tooltip: Scoring back to 1 block down, 0 up, reach 4
propwash.race.score.pole.wall: Gate poles on a wall don't score – only standing, hanging and stacked poles go into a course
propwash.race.score.pole.in_course: A gate pole in a course always scores – “None” only works after “Remove from course”
propwash.race.score.pole.label: %s · %s · %s
propwash.race.nudge.reset.tooltip: Back to where it stands in the world
propwash.race.nudge.limit: Moved too far – at most %s blocks per axis at a time
propwash.race.freeform.open_keys: %s + right-click: ignore gaps (rectangle spanned by the blocks that are there)
propwash.race.edit.fine.move: Ctrl: 1/16 block (one pixel) · Ctrl+Shift: 1/32 block (half a pixel)
propwash.race.edit.freeform.heading: Orientation
propwash.race.edit.freeform.heading.tool: Turns the lying gate in steps of 90°. Its redstone output, the rim block framed in red, turns with it: 0° north rim, 90° east, 180° south, 270° west. A newly placed gate has the output on your side. In a course the leaderboard stays: only the output turns, not the way through the gate.
